cand.title: Expo Transporte ANPACT 2027
cand.excerpt: High event credibility and geographic fit; current-edition accessibility is constrained by a confirmed non-hotel venue, so the opportunity is ranked for overflow/ancillary or future capture rather than assumed open inventory.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Alejandro Osorio Carranza, president of the Expo Transporte Committee, is the strongest event-side relationship/referral contact. Tatiana Poblete Ritschel, General Director of Check In Mexico, is a relevant senior housing intermediary. Gloria Sánchez, Operations Manager at Checkin México, is an operational routing candidate. Rogelio Arzate is ANPACT executive president and an executive sponsor, not a verified hotel buyer. No named person’s hotel-contract signature authority was established.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: 10–12 November 2027 at Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates on the event site, corroborated by the August 2026 launch reporting, not the announcement date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: strong urban business-hotel fit for exhibitor teams, visiting industry delegations and supplementary meetings, rather than a resort retreat. This uses the supplied 216-room product and Expo-corridor positioning. Marriott independently describes the hotel as minutes from Expo Guadalajara; its dedicated events page publishes 12 event rooms, 1,654 sq m total event space and a largest-space capacity of 500. The event’s 2025 report records 110 council meetings, assemblies, conferences, panels and forums, supporting an ancillary-meetings sales thesis, not proof any are seeking a hotel. The Sheraton cannot be positioned as a replacement for the main heavy-vehicle exhibition.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara is the announced 2027 exhibition venue, not a competing hotel. Public announcements establish the venue selection, not access to a signed venue contract. They do not establish exclusive accommodation commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified destination history: Guadalajara in 2015 and 2017; Puebla in 2019 and 2022; Guadalajara again in 2023 and 2025, with 2027 confirmed there. The verified sequence is not annual and is not evidence of a formal alternating-city rotation. No post-2027 dates or destinations were established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel supplier sourcing status: unknown/unconfirmed, not proven open or closed. Checkin México operates a dedicated 2027 booking page with hotel rates, a two-night minimum and a central reservations route for more than nine rooms: reservaciones@checkinmexico.com. Its corporate page explicitly invites commercial relationships to offer suppliers’ services, but that general invitation is not an event-specific RFP or acceptance of new hotels. No reviewed source establishes Checkin exclusivity or an official ANPACT appointment; no direct event-site referral was verified. Booking availability is not procurement availability.
findings.organizationStructure: ANPACT is the Asociación Nacional de Productores de Autobuses, Camiones y Tractocamiones, the industry association organizing the exhibition. Expo Guadalajara is the venue; the Expo Transporte Committee supplies event leadership; Checkin México describes its separate business as accommodation administration/operation and hotel alliances. No separately appointed PCO/DMC or exclusive housing contractor was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The 2027 Checkin page already markets numerous competing hotels, including Presidente InterContinental, Guadalajara Plaza Expo, Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo, City Express Plus Expo, Holiday Inn Express Guadalajara Expo, Hampton by Hilton, AC Hotel Guadalajara Expo, RIU Plaza, JW Marriott and others. Sheraton Guadalajara Expo was not listed in the page reviewed. Listings establish marketed accommodation options, not executed block contracts. A hotel-association statement reported 92% city hotel occupancy during the 2025 edition; this is historical compression evidence, not verified 2027 overflow, sellout or displaced room demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Tatiana Poblete Ritschel through Checkin’s published group-reservations route, reservaciones@checkinmexico.com, asking for the 2027 hotel-alliance decision-maker and whether additional Expo-corridor hotels can be considered. In parallel, write to info@expotransporte.com for Alejandro Osorio Carranza’s team to confirm the authorized housing channel and route exhibitor/delegation requirements. Offer a capacity-checked proposal for guestrooms and small/medium corporate functions around 10–12 November 2027; ask for actual stay patterns, group sizes, transport needs, commissions, release dates and decision timing before pricing or holding inventory. Do not represent this as an active RFP, contracted block or confirmed overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, the main venue is already selected. Accommodation-channel participation and exhibitor-led rooms/meetings remain commercially plausible but unconfirmed. Neither the non-hotel venue nor existing hotel listings justify declaring all guestrooms closed to Sheraton. No public 2027 hotel RFP, supplier deadline, Sheraton allocation or overflow request was established.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize entry into the 2027 hotel programme or direct exhibitor-group accounts, then retain the association/intermediary relationship for later cycles. Do not wait for a main-event relocation: the current venue complements rather than competes with the hotel’s rooms. Recurrence is verified historically, but any edition after 2027, its city and any competitive procurement window remain unconfirmed.
